reviewer: author self-review; no independent subagent available
checks: default Racket program is byte-identical to the selected canonical authority
alternate Racket program is distinct and source-bound
adapter loads only its adjacent prototype and rejects undeclared settings
seed/demo/query controls reject bool and out-of-range values
2-6 demonstration and 1-4 query boundaries are exercised
minimum demonstrations expose both anchor classes and alternate observed source order
public turns expose one query input without settings, program, answers, future queries, or total-count hints
30x30 fourth-query content is substantive rather than padded
qualification binds the final source closure and protected Racket execution
finite shortcut audit uses demonstration labels only and reports zero survivors
rulings: The manifest's reported_checks text is retained as its prequalification snapshot; changing the source-bound manifest after qualification would invalidate that qualification. Final counts and status are recorded in REVIEW.md, RESULTS.json, and qualification-recheck.json.
limits: Author self-review is weaker than an independent fresh-context review.
